create.name: Suzi von Mensenkampff
create.bio:
Suzi von Mensenkampff is an Irish meditation and Ayurveda teacher who runs Wake Up Little Suzi from West Cork. For years she worked in interior design and brought up her children; a meeting with Deepak Chopra at the Chopra Center in 2011 sent her into the study of meditation, yoga and Ayurveda, and in 2012 she qualified as a Chopra-certified Vedic educator. She then trained with the McLean Meditation Institute, in both Sedona and Santa Barbara, and later advised its teacher trainees. She also studied Ayurveda for several years with Dr. Shivani Sood in Dharamsala. She has volunteered with a yoga charity in Kolkata and co-founded Dharma Tours, leading retreats in Sikkim and Bhutan.

Primordial Sound Meditation, the mantra practice of the Chopra lineage, is at the centre of her teaching, and she gives personal mantras through a four-part online programme. Around it she offers a beginners' meditation course, an eight-week dream yoga journey and one-to-one dream work, a free Mindful Monday sit on Zoom each week, retreats abroad and mindfulness programmes for companies. Her teaching draws on the Yoga Sutras and the Upanishads alongside current thinking about consciousness, and she co-hosts the In12D podcast.

courses.title: Primordial Sound Meditation online programme
courses.description: A self-paced course in four sessions in which Suzi gives each student a personal mantra, passed on privately in the oral way, and shows how to build a steady daily practice around it.

courses.title: Dream Yoga
courses.description: An eight-week online journey that brings awareness into waking life, dreams and deep sleep, with dream recall, intention setting and practices for becoming lucid, drawing on yogic tradition and modern research.

courses.title: Dream Yoga 1:1
courses.description: An hour-long private online session exploring the symbols and patterns in your own dreams and strengthening lucid awareness.

courses.title: Learn to Meditate
courses.description: An online course for complete beginners covering how meditation works, simple breath and awareness practices, handling a busy mind and setting up a home practice.

free_resources.title: Mindful Monday
free_resources.description: A free weekly group meditation on Zoom; sign up on her home page to receive the link.
